sentences.show: A spy plane's photos began 13 days that nearly ended the world.
On this day in 1962, President Kennedy was shown the pictures.
Two days earlier, a U-2 pilot had taken 928 photos over Cuba.
In them: Soviet nuclear missile sites, a short flight from America.
His military chiefs wanted an attack, and an invasion.
Kennedy chose a naval blockade instead, and called it a "quarantine".
On October 27th, an American spy plane was shot down over Cuba.
That same day, U.S. destroyers dropped practice depth charges on a Soviet submarine.
Its captain believed the war had begun, and prepared a nuclear torpedo.
One officer refused. His name was Vasily Arkhipov.
The next day, Khrushchev agreed to take the missiles away.
In secret, America agreed to remove its own — from Turkey.
Also on this day: London's Parliament burned down, and the Disney brothers opened their studio.
